hello.speaker: keeper
hello.text: The lanterns are filed by debt, not by name. I no longer know whether that was mercy or simply easier bookkeeping.

choices.text: [Succubus Spittle] Offer a brief kiss; use the contact to charm him.
Ask about the history of this place.

plain.speaker: keeper
plain.text: Show me the receipt filed in the entrance records and I will explain the mechanism.

alternative.speaker: keeper
alternative.text: I will not risk my livelihood on a stranger’s word. Bring evidence. You can still learn what you need without changing my mind.

document.speaker: keeper
document.text: That record settles it. No favour owed.

information.speaker: keeper
information.text: Mara’s lantern responds to her name and her bell. The shelves of names also record the counterseal’s location. Read them before entering the inner chamber.

charmed.speaker: keeper
charmed.text: His reserve softens for this conversation. Mara’s lantern responds to her name and her bell. The shelves of names also record the counterseal’s location. Read them before entering the inner chamber. The warmth fades as you part. Nothing here binds him to silence or loyalty.

resisted.speaker: keeper
resisted.text: He draws away. “That felt like more than a greeting. Speak plainly if you want something.” The attempt fails; ordinary conversation and the evidence route remain open.

lore.speaker: keeper
lore.text: The archlord’s collectors turned help into debt. A meal became a favour, a favour became an oath, and every oath acquired a clause its signer had never seen. Some of us learned not to ask questions. That habit has lasted longer than the fear that taught it.
